api document of class com.networknt.sche:
* Used for creating a schema with validators for validating inputs. This is * created using {@link JsonSchemaFactory#getInstance(VersionFlag, Consumer)} * and should be cached for performance. *

* This is the core of json constraint implementation. It parses json constraint * file and generates JsonValidators. The class is thread safe, once it is * constructed, it can be used to validate multiple json data concurrently. *

* JsonSchema instances are thread-safe provided its configuration is not * modified.
api document of method validate(JsonNode:

* Note that since Draft 2019-09 by default format generates only annotations * and not assertions. *

* Use {@link ExecutionConfig#setFormatAssertionsEnabled(Boolean)} to override * the default. * * @param rootNode the root node * @param executionCustomizer the execution customizer * @return the assertions
